PLAN "PCOS Insulin Sensitivity Strength Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build strength and improve insulin sensitivity"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Sustainable training without overtraining"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          leg_swings 1x10
          hip_circles 1x10
          goblet_squat 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 1x10
          scapular_retraction 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          bird_dog 2x8
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          pigeon_pose 1m
          child_pose 1m
